clips.caption:
Tell a friend you're starting a restaurant and watch what happens.

Out loud they say go for it. Kevin Trudeau says underneath, a different voice runs: I hope he fails, I hope he fails.

He calls it counter intention - the gap between what people say to your face and what they quietly hope happens. Even people who love you carry it, because your rise moves the bar they're measured against.

That's why the goal stays untold until it's real.

Would your closest friend really want you to out-earn them tenfold?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #successmindset #wealthmindset #selfimprovement #moneymindset

A man stands on stage, arm held straight out, told simply to resist.

Kevin Trudeau describes the old muscle-testing demonstration: hold up one finger while the room sends love, and the arm stays locked. Hold up two fingers while the room silently sends hate, and the same strong arm drops instantly - no fatigue, no warning, just intention in the air.

He says that's the exact force friends and family aim at your goals in silence.

If strangers can move your arm with a thought, what is your own family doing to your dream?

#kevintrudeau #energy #mindpower #manifestation #mindset #success

A planted seed needs protecting - from birds, from insects, from the rabbits that show up once it sprouts.

Kevin Trudeau says a dream works the same way, which is why he asks it straight: are your friends and family really silent weapons pointed at your success? His own answer - subconsciously, yes.

Not because they wish you harm, but because your growth reminds them of their own stall.

So the dream stays buried until it's strong enough to survive daylight.

Who in your life would feel smaller the day you won big?

#kevintrudeau #familydynamics #mindset #goals #successmindset #selfimprovement

There is exactly one situation where Kevin Trudeau says it's safe to say your goal out loud.

He calls it the mastermind principle: two or more people chasing the identical goal, in harmony, each one winning if it happens. A business partner who wants the same expansion. A spouse who wants the same lake house. No competing interest, no counter intention.

Everyone else still gets silence, because a shared goal and a borrowed one aren't the same thing.

Who in your life actually wants the exact outcome you do?

#kevintrudeau #mastermind #successmindset #wealthmindset #businessmindset #mindset

Most people get zero details about your goals. Kevin Trudeau says a small handful of groups are the exception.

He names them directly: a fraternal organization like the one he belonged to, or a group like YPO or the Global Information Network, bound by a pledge to support each other instead of quietly competing. Inside those rooms, saying your goal out loud brings help, not resentment.

Outside them, his rule returns in full - don't tell anybody.

Do you actually have a room like that, or just a group chat?
